title: Check File Exists
description: Verify that a required file exists and is readable.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

FILE="${1:-}"

if [[ -z "$FILE" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 /path/to/file" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [[ -f "$FILE" && -r "$FILE" ]]; then
    echo "OK: File exists and is readable: $FILE"
else
    echo "ERROR: File is missing or not readable: $FILE" >&2
    exit 1
fi
